_readme: Machine-readable export of the Beauticate Affiliate Vault. Humans edit the
Google Sheet ('Beauticate Affiliate Vault — Master'); this file mirrors it and
is what the geo link resolver (lib/product-links.ts) reads at build time.
Resolution order for a given AU link, first hit wins:
1. products[..]  — hand-picked per-product intl link (hero tier).
2. brands[..]    — brand-level intl store, keyed by the AU link's host.
3. retailerMap[..] — AU retailer -> intl retailer search, keyed by AU host.
4. nothing       — leave the AU link bare; Skimlinks monetises the long tail.
IMPORTANT: retailerMap and brands entries are only used when "verified": true.
An unverified entry is inert — it falls through to the next layer. This keeps
un-checked search-URL patterns from shipping to readers. Verify with:
which loads each URL and flags anything that 404s or bounces to a homepage.

mecca.com._note: Mecca is a swap, not a destination — no affiliate value. AU readers should go to brand DTC or a Skimlinks-monetised retailer; intl readers to Sephora US / Dermstore.

adorebeauty.com.au._note: Partnerize — keep AU links exactly as they are, they pay better than Skimlinks. Geo-gate to AU/NZ only.

myer.com.au._note: Myer links are confirmed working — do not rewrite the AU side.

_shopReadme: Option A: the Beauticate Shop can only ship within Australia (single General
shipping profile, fulfilment routed to partner brands via Modern Dropship).
Rather than show international visitors a checkout that cannot fulfil, the
buy action is substituted for an affiliate link to a stockist that ships to
them. Same country signal as editorial, one system.
byHandle wins over byVendor. Both honour "verified": true. With no entry,
the buy box tells the reader plainly that we ship AU/NZ only rather than
letting them fill a cart they cannot check out.
